FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky:
No one believes me, but I saw this gigantic POKéMON in the sky.
It seemed to squirm as it flew toward ROUTE 131.
By the way… Sniff… Um… You, uh…smell singed.
Were you at a volcano or something?
FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym:
I want to go to the POKéMON GYM, but something's blocking the way.
After all the bother I went through training on ROUTE 120…
FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON with me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.
FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRain:
The ground absorbs rainwater, and trees grow by drinking that water…
Our FORTREE CITY exists because there's both water and soil.
FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLivel:
The CITY consists of homes built on trees.
Perhaps because of that lifestyle, everyone is healthy and lively.
Why, even myself--I feel as if I've grown thirty years younger.
FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWi:
Living on top of trees is okay.
But sometimes BUG POKéMON come in through windows. It can be really startling.
FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTr: There are POKéMON that evolve when you trade them! That's what I heard.
FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable: Something unseeable is in the way.
FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope:
Something unseeable is in the way.
Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?
FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFl:
{PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.
An invisible POKéMON became completely visible!
The startled POKéMON fled!
FortreeCity_Text_CitySign: FORTREE CITY “The treetop city that frolics with nature.”
FortreeCity_Text_GymSign:
FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: WINONA
“The bird user taking flight into the world.”
